text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Hot spring inns. Long ago, they were said
to be holy ground for board gamers.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Playing cards, hanafuda, mahjong...
A variety of games were played by the tour group.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: That paradise is now—revived across time!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, Trainer.
To establish a new retreat style
for board gamers.

The hot spring trip between two hardcore gamers was full of dreams even before departure.
And then—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a nice bath...
Now then, freshly out of the bath—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heavy Board Game Tournament!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, we've got all the time in the world.
In that case, it's gotta be heavy games, heavy games all the way."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Heavy board games."
This refers to a group of games that require vast amounts of time,
making them virtually impossible to play casually.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
While active in racing,
hardcore gaming is a pipe dream. But...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"In this place, without having to worry about time limits, I can play as much as I want...
Ah, I feel like I'm going to lose my mind."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, which one should we start with?! Which one?!
Wooooh, I'm getting so hyped up~~~!
And so, the grand heavy-weight board game tournament began.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this super-long vertical map sheet...
I can spread it out completely in this room!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, let it begin. A century-long, inter-alliance war
spanning the entire galaxy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, it stands! After three grueling hours of gathering
materials non-stop, the "Tower of Babel" has finally...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"That's the first time I've ever seen one built in real play...!
Photos, I've gotta take tons of photos!"

A series of precious gaming experiences that one normally couldn't have.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Here's your food~.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
ââ!?
Ohh, this board game tournament is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Meals get delivered automatically even without ordering online? And made with high-end ingredients by hand, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Unlimited heavy gaming.
On top of that, top-tier meals served automatically.
A truly divine environment.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is a board game cafe for a new era.
It's Board Game Cafe 2.0.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, isn't that just greaaat?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Having worked so hard to get this far.
And now even being able to go on a trip like this.

For a board gamer,
there could be no greater happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Trainer.
I just thought of something great.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In the future, once we're even more successful—wanna build a "Board Game Ryokan"?
choice_data_list: An inn where you can play board games?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I brought these myself today, but beforehand,
I'll keep a large stock of board games ready at all times...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, anyone will be able to
easily enjoy an experience like today's."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: An eternal... paradise is born.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it'd be nice if we could.
Yeah, it'd be nice if that happens.

text_block_list.text: It would be truly wonderful if we could pull that off.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Alright, Trainer, I've decided.
In the future, I—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To become the ruler of the Twinkle Series.
And at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'll become the inn manager!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Ruler & Manager.
I shall achieve both.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What should your position be...?
Trainer and young master?
No, co-manager sounds nice too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What should your position be...?
Trainer and proprietress?
No, co-manager sounds nice too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, once we're done eating, let's play one more round.
We'll open all the unopened packages, too.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Rulership...
